goal: Remove Trigger.dev from CFN and Math platforms where it adds unnecessary complexity, consolidate to SEO platform where it provides genuine value for long-running scraping tasks

rationale.problem: Trigger.dev adds enterprise-grade distributed orchestration infrastructure (9 Docker containers, 302MB) for use cases that work fine with local Promise.all()
rationale.analysis: Provider routing strategy (opus→zai→cerebras) now handles model selection at API level, eliminating original Trigger.dev rationale
rationale.outcome: Simpler architecture: direct Cerebras API calls for CFN/Math, Trigger.dev only for SEO scraping where multi-worker distribution provides 3-5x throughput

phases.name: Extract Core Logic
phases.description: Extract valuable AI logic from Trigger.dev task wrappers into standalone modules

sprints.name: Create Local MDAP Library Structure
sprints.description: Set up lib/mdap/ directory structure and copy framework-agnostic modules
criteria: lib/mdap/ directory created with proper structure
types.ts contains shared interfaces (CompilerError, FixInstruction, etc.)

sprints.name: Extract Decomposers
sprints.description: Extract decomposer logic from Trigger.dev task() wrappers to standalone async functions
criteria: Each decomposer is a standalone async function (not task() wrapped)
Function signature: async function decompose{Type}(payload): Promise<Analysis>
All GLM 4.6 calls use callGLMWithThinking from glm-client.ts
JSON parsing uses parseJSONFromResponse from validation.ts
Unit tests pass for each decomposer

context.pattern: Remove task({}) wrapper, keep run() body as standalone function

sprints.name: Extract Implementer
sprints.description: Extract MDAP implementer with diff mode, validation, and retry logic
criteria: implementer.ts exports async function implement(payload): Promise<Result>
Diff mode logic preserved (extractErrorContext, applyFixes, validateSyntax)
NACK retry loop preserved for validation failures
diff-applicator.ts contains pure functions for fix application

sprints.name: Create Local Orchestrator
sprints.description: Create simple orchestrator using Promise.all instead of Trigger.dev SDK
criteria: Gate check runs test command via execSync
Iteration loop with configurable max iterations
No Redis coordination (not needed for local execution)

sprints.name: Port Error Fixer from OurStories
sprints.description: Port P0 fixes from OurStories cerebras-parallel-fixer to lib/mdap/error-fixer.ts
criteria: HARD_ERRORS array for borrow checker errors to skip
Dynamic context sizing (15-100 lines based on error type)

phases.name: Remove Trigger.dev from CFN
phases.description: Delete Trigger.dev infrastructure and update CFN to use local orchestration

sprints.name: Delete Trigger.dev v4 Infrastructure
sprints.description: Remove the 302MB trigger-dev-v4 directory and related configs
criteria: No broken imports referencing deleted files
docker-compose files updated to remove trigger services

context.rationale: Infrastructure is upstream Trigger.dev repo clone, can be re-cloned if needed

sprints.name: Remove Trigger.dev Task Definitions
sprints.description: Delete Trigger.dev-specific task wrappers (logic already extracted to lib/mdap/)
criteria: Decomposer task files deleted (logic in lib/mdap/decomposers/)
Implementer task file deleted (logic in lib/mdap/implementer.ts)

context.verify_extraction: Ensure all logic is in lib/mdap/ before deletion

sprints.name: Update CLI Commands
sprints.description: Update CFN Loop CLI commands to use local orchestrator instead of Trigger.dev SDK
criteria: Replace tasks.trigger() with direct orchestrate() call
CLI commands work end-to-end with local orchestration

sprints.name: Update Package Dependencies
sprints.description: Remove @trigger.dev/sdk from package.json and update .env

sprints.name: Update Documentation
sprints.description: Update CLAUDE.md and related docs to remove Trigger.dev references
criteria: Remove Trigger.dev infrastructure sections from docker/CLAUDE.md
Update CLAUDE.md to reference lib/mdap/ instead of Trigger.dev tasks

phases.name: Remove Trigger.dev from Math Platform
phases.description: Clean up Trigger.dev from Math Intelligence Platform (theory explorer already local)

sprints.name: Delete Math Platform Trigger.dev Directory
sprints.description: Remove trigger-dev/ from math-intelligence-platform

context.verification: Theory explorer uses Promise.all(), not Trigger.dev

phases.name: Migrate Trigger.dev to SEO Platform
phases.description: Set up Trigger.dev in SEO Intelligence Platform for long-running scraping tasks

sprints.name: Copy Infrastructure to SEO Platform
sprints.description: Copy Trigger.dev v4 infrastructure from CFN to SEO platform
criteria: webapp and worker docker-compose files present

sprints.name: Create Firecrawl Batch Scraping Task
sprints.description: Create Trigger.dev task for parallel web scraping via Firecrawl
criteria: Task accepts { urls: string[], options?: ScrapeOptions }
Processes URLs in parallel with configurable concurrency

context.benefit: 3-5x throughput via Trigger.dev workers vs single-process Promise.all

sprints.name: Create Content Publishing Task
sprints.description: Create Trigger.dev task for scheduled content publishing
criteria: Waits until scheduled time if in future

context.replaces: Custom polling queue in scheduler.ts (1136 lines)

sprints.name: Create Rank Tracking Task with Schedule
sprints.description: Create scheduled Trigger.dev task for daily rank tracking
criteria: Task accepts { keywords: string[], domains: string[] }
Scheduled version runs daily at 6 AM (cron: '0 6 * * *')
Automatic retry on DataForSEO API failures

context.benefit: Reliable scheduled execution, automatic retry, observability dashboard

sprints.name: Create Trigger.dev Configuration
sprints.description: Set up trigger.config.ts and package.json for SEO platform
criteria: trigger.config.ts with project ID and settings
maxDuration set to 600 (10 min for long scraping)

phases.name: Verification and Cleanup
phases.description: Verify all systems work and clean up temporary files

sprints.name: Verify CFN Local Orchestration
sprints.description: End-to-end test of CFN Loop with local orchestrator
criteria: npm test passes for all lib/mdap/ modules
Gate check correctly parses test output

sprints.name: Verify Math Platform
sprints.description: Verify Math Intelligence Platform works without Trigger.dev
criteria: No @trigger.dev imports in codebase (grep returns empty)
Theory explorer generates and validates theories

sprints.name: Verify SEO Platform Trigger.dev
sprints.description: End-to-end test of Trigger.dev tasks in SEO platform
criteria: rank-tracker scheduled task appears in dashboard
Task results visible in Trigger.dev UI

sprints.name: Final Cleanup
sprints.description: Remove temporary files and update final documentation
criteria: No orphaned files referencing Trigger.dev in CFN

rollback_plan.cfn: git checkout HEAD -- docker/trigger-dev/ package.json && npm install
rollback_plan.seo: rm -rf docker/trigger-dev/ trigger.config.ts src/trigger/ && git checkout HEAD -- package.json && npm install
